messages.subject: cov matrix
parts: Is there a way to compute a covariance matrix in Stan?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] cov matrix
parts:
There's no built-in sample covariance or correlation)
function. We should add one. I created an issue:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/1284

Is this what it should look like:

matrix[K,K] sample_cov(matrix[N,K] x);

And how about:

matrix[K,K] sample_cov(vector[K] x[N]);
matrix[K,K] sample_cov(row_vector[K] x[N]);

or even

matrix[K,K] sample_cov(real x[N,K]);

?

And presumably we should also have sample_corr.

- Bob
